answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 148774 Country: India Title: Cancer Disease solution by Quran Question: My mother is suffering from cancer for last 2 years. The doctors have done operation last 6 months. The treatment is going on by Govt hospital. So please suggest me any dua to remove this disease. Answer ID: 148774 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 653/629/M=5/1438) Read Surah Fatiha seven times with durood 11-11 times before and after and blow on water and give it to her to drink. Also recite Ya Salam ( یَا سَلامُ ) hundred times and blow over her body in the morning and evening. May Allah cure your mother! Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
